text:
alex: Deploybot just tried to promote staging manifest but failed due to concurrent promote. saw ephemeral tag flip during push. logs attached: https://ci.internal/build/1234
maria: Ugh... is the manifest list missing a buildid annotation?
alex: Looks like two pushes for same tag at 2024-10-17T12:30Z. Cosign attestation for the later push didn't appear before promotion window.
deploybot: @channel promotion aborted: MANIFEST_MISMATCH (code 409). Details: digest mismatch between staging and canary. See /var/log/deploybot/promote-1729123456.log
sam: Can we pin the release to the last-known-good digest and re-run the promote? I'd prefer avoid republishing if possible.
jess: Agree with pin. Also need to update release notes: mention republish avoided + remediation steps.
alex: Pin decision sounds right. Ops: can we backfill attestation later and republish as a hotfix if needed?
ops-bot: Backfill ok but requires KMS-approval flow + release owner signoff. Manual step: `deploybot promote --pin-digest sha256:abcd... --env staging`
sam: OK let's pin to sha256:abcd1234 (previous digest). Can we schedule a small change window to rerun promote at 13:00 UTC?
maria: 13:00 UTC works. I'll draft release note blurb and add rollback criteria.
jess: Rollback criteria: if canary error-rate > 2% or latency increase > 20% within first 5m -> rollback to sha256:abcd1234
alex: I'll open a short PR against release notes and add a changelog entry. Also adding a ticket to re-run attestation backfill.
deploybot: Promotion queued with pin sha256:abcd1234, scheduled at 1729126800 (13:00 UTC). Will report status here.
alex: Thanks. tagging releases team for visibility @release-team :eyes:
sam: will monitor canary after promote and post follow-ups.
jess: thx all :thumbsup:
